promises.label: FY26 revenue growth guidance raised
promises.quote: we are improving our revenue guidance now for FY26 to 3% to 5% in constant currency

promises.speaker: C. Vijayakumar

promises.label: Normalized margin 19-20% aspiration

promises.label: Restructuring costs 30-40 bps impact

promises.label: Utilization follow-on impact 10-20 bps
promises.quote: utilization... will have some follow on impact in the subsequent quarters and we expect that to have an impact of 10-20 basis points

promises.label: Large deal ramp fully by Q3
